subject: Re: MAP: Novafin implementation milestones & target close
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novafin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Novafin MAP draft & next steps

Alex — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Objectives: Production-grade LLM inference for customer support triage and knowledge base augmentation.
- Success metrics: <=200ms p95 latency for generation, 5% reduction in support deflection in Q3.
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence for hosted deployment, procurement timeline (PO + SOW), and data residency for EU customers (not in scope for first phase).

I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Novafin_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and target dates. Highlights:
- Milestone 1: Pilot environment + data ingestion — target 2027-05-20 — Owner: Novafin (Alex/Sara) / Redwood (Jordan)
- Milestone 2: SOC2 cross-check & access controls — target 2027-05-30 — Owner: Novafin security / Redwood security
- Milestone 3: Pilot validation + quality evals — target 2027-06-10 — Owner: Novafin product / Redwood success
- Milestone 4: Production cutover & billing setup — target 2027-06-30 — Owner: Procurement / Redwood account team

Can you confirm owners and whether the target close of 2027-06-30 is realistic? If there are any dependencies we missed, call them out and I'll update the MAP.

Next steps:
- Alex / Sara: confirm owners and outstanding procurement items (PR/PO/SOW) by EOD 2027-04-28
- Jordan: scope final network/NAT requirements and provide SOC2 evidence checklist by 2027-05-05
- Marissa: update MAP and schedule weekly 15-min checkpoints starting week of 2027-05-03

Attachment: Novafin_MAP_v1.xlsx (Milestones, owners, dates - editable)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Novafin MAP draft & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP. Quick notes from our side after internal sync:

- Overall looks good. Couple of asks/edits:
  - Procurement: Sara (cc) will lead PR/PO; she needs an estimated MRR/commit and SOW template. Can you provide a ballpark run-rate by 2027-04-30?
  - SOC2: our security team wants a short evidence checklist and expected delivery date for the audit artifacts. Can Jordan share the checklist?
  - Target close: internal expectation is to aim for mid-June rather than EOM — would you be open to target close 2027-06-15?

I'm attaching a small set of comments in the MAP (inline); main change is moving onboarding validation window earlier if SOC2 evidence is available by 2027-05-20.

Folks — Sara will coordinate procurement questions. Marissa/Jordan, if you can update the MAP with the procurement row and estimated run-rate, we can confirm next week.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, Novafin
alex.johnson@novafin.com | +1 212-555-0789

Subject: Updated MAP (v2) + SOC2 checklist

Hi Alex / team — attached is Novafin_MAP_v2.xlsx with the procurement row added and an estimated monthly run-rate (banded: $6k-9k) based on the pilot token volumes you shared. I also included the SOC2 evidence checklist we've historically provided to customers for hosted deployments.

Key changes in v2:
- Procurement row: SOW draft and payment terms (Owner: Novafin procurement / Redwood legal) — targeted PO by 2027-05-18
- SOC2 checklist: expected artifacts and where we can host encrypted evidence (Redwood can provide read-only audit access)
- Target close: moved to 2027-06-15 per your ask; pilot validation target 2027-06-01 (one week earlier than v1)

Dependencies to highlight:
- SOC2 artifact delivery (Novafin security) — expected by 2027-05-20. If delayed, we will need to extend pilot validation into mid-June.
- Data access sign-off: Novafin legal needs the data processing addendum signed before we ingest production samples.

Please review v2 and leave comments in the sheet; I'm happy to iterate. Planning to schedule a 15-min weekly checkpoint every Monday at 09:00 PT starting 2027-05-03 — Marissa will send calendar invites.

Attachment: Novafin_MAP_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

2) Alex / Security — confirm SOC2 artifact delivery or update expected date.
3) Rishi (Redwood legal) — I'll loop you into the DPA thread; please advise on any Redwood changes needed this week.
